A1.justification: Both PDFs describe E3AD and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Corresponding material can be matched across pagination and appendix renumbering, allowing identifiable deletions to be distinguished from relocations.

before.justification: v1 reports original grounding, planning, emotion-estimation, ablation, and DPO results, plus a 217-participant user study.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–6 and A1 and the user-study outcomes in Section 4.7 and Figure 7.

M1.justification: The VAD emotion model, egocentric/allocentric pathways, action decoder, training objectives, DPO construction, and inference procedure remain unchanged. The decoder integration and prompt templates also match across the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use Talk2Car, DrivePilot, MoCAD, and Talk2Car-Trajectory, including the same corner-case and long-text scenarios. The 217-participant user study remains; removal of its demographic documentation does not establish changed population coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–4. Although v1's user-study appendix is deleted, Figure 7 still compares E3AD against CAVG, FSDrive-FT, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, and Qwen3-VL-8B.

E3.justification: The stated dataset splits, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, model configurations, and training settings are unchanged. Both versions describe participants ranking five anonymized systems on the same dimensions; deleting supporting procedural descriptions does not establish a revised study design.

E4.justification: Figure 3 removes the split-wise analysis of neutral versus other command emotions. The remaining VAD-distribution and coverage analyses, component ablations, DPO analyses, and qualitative case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Deleting v1 Appendix C.4 removes the explanation that Figure 7's error bars represent standard deviations, while the bars remain. Table 1's uncertainty values are unchanged, with no added run counts, seeds, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: v2 removes Figure 3's neutral-command proportions of 95.6%, 95.0%, and 94.4% across the training, validation, and test splits, and the participant-composition results in former Figure A2. Tables 1–6 and A1 and Figure 7's user-study outcomes remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, loss equations, preference-pair construction, and appendix metric definitions remain unchanged. Neither version adds or removes a theorem, proof, or substantive derivation.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the OD-E2E task formulation, emotion-aware VLA contribution, and claims of improved grounding, planning, and emotion estimation. Small abstract and prose edits do not materially change these claims.

C2.justification: Deleting v1 Appendix C.4 removes age-specific interpretations linking younger participants' preferences to responsiveness and older participants' safety/comfort ratings to trust. The main emotion-action interpretations and future-work discussion remain.

D1.justification: v2 removes user-study documentation covering participant demographics and experience, operational definitions of rating dimensions, and conversion of ranks into scores. Data construction, decoder integration, training hyperparameters, hardware, and prompt documentation are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to A cognitive-driven trajectory prediction model, Minds on the move, and RouteKG, and removes InTent. These are limited citation changes; the related-work framework and central novelty positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: There are light abstract and prose edits, deletion of the dedicated user-study appendix, and renumbering of the subsequent appendices and cross-references. The main section order and most explanatory text remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 changes from four panels to three horizontally arranged VAD plots, but its caption still describes four panels, including the deleted bar chart. The demographic sunburst in former Figure A2 is removed; subsequent appendix figures are renumbered and relocated.

improvement.justification: The core method and performance evidence remain intact, but deleting the user-study demographics, scoring explanation, and error-bar definition makes its retained findings harder to assess. Figure 3 also loses quantitative evidence and acquires a caption mismatch. The limited wording and citation updates do not offset these losses in transparency and presentation accuracy.
